headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 淡い青とブラッシュシルバーを軸に、赤い再生・送信アイコンをアクセントにしたエディトリアルな抽象画面。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE premium Chrome extension store listing promotional artwork, landscape 11:7 aspect ratio, target 1760 x 1120 pixels. It must remain clear when reduced to 220 x 140. This is an abstract editorial design, never a screenshot or photoreal scene.

Art direction: ice-blue paper and brushed silver with small, saturated YouTube-red accents. Refined contemporary editorial technology campaign: beautiful grotesk typography, confident spacing, quiet material contrast, a slight silver foil rim and very subtle crisp depth, restrained hard-edged shadows, intentional negative space. Not neon, not dark gaming art, not chrome blobs or generic AI gloss. White/ivory, very pale ice blue, silver, dark ink and red.

Composition: a precise large 16:9 video screen occupies the lower two-thirds. Its entire outer perimeter is one silver frame with four small fullscreen corner brackets at the OUTER four corners of the COMPLETE screen. A simple red play triangle is on the left INSIDE that screen. A vertical chat pane is OVERLAID INSIDE the right side of the SAME video, with generous inset from the screen's outer edge on ALL sides. The full video remains visually behind and around this pane. Chat has only three horizontal lines and small circular bullets and an abstract send triangle. No fake message words, names, timestamps, controls or dashboard. It must clearly mean chat stays in fullscreen rather than beside the fullscreen.

Exactly three text elements on the top third, each appearing ONCE: "YouTube" as a readable small ink label at upper left; "Fullscreen" as the main large ink headline; "Live Chat" as large red companion headline. No other wording, numbers, slogan, watermark or badges. Spelling is exact: Y-o-u-T-u-b-e; F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n (one word); L-i-v-e space C-h-a-t. Maintain seven percent text safe margins on all edges, do not crop any letters. Big type with enough breathing room. Every text element clearly separate from diagram.
No humans, gaming, landscapes, photos, browser chrome, real content, or invented official endorsements. Edge-to-edge finished marketing image, not a framed poster on a surface.

revisions.purpose: Enlarge YouTube label for listing thumbnail legibility
revisions.prompt:
Make ONE focused typography edit to this existing promotional image. Enlarge ONLY the upper-left word "YouTube" to roughly twice its present size, so its capital letters are about85–90 pixels high on this1572 by1001 canvas. It must be comfortably readable when the image is reduced to220 by140. Preserve the exact spelling YouTube, with capital Y and T, appearing once. Keep it in dark ink, keep the same bold font character and upper-left alignment, with safe margins and clear separation from the headline below. If a little more room is needed, shift the Fullscreen / Live Chat headline slightly down without changing its size. Do not let any letters overlap.

Preserve EVERY other element: exactly the existing Fullscreen and Live Chat wording once each, their colors and large type; the abstract brushed silver and ice-blue diagonal surface; silver video frame and all four fullscreen corners; red play triangle; white chat pane overlaid INSIDE the video with its three anonymous rows and red send symbol. Same palette, material finish, abstract composition, full uncropped content and landscape11:7 aspect ratio. No photos, scene, landscape, new word, duplicated word, watermark or other addition. Change only YouTube label size and minimal spacing needed.

verification.words: Exact words YouTube, Fullscreen and Live Chat each once; no additional visible text.
verification.composition: Chat overlay visibly inside the fullscreen video boundary.
verification.imageInspection: Actual selected workspace PNG inspected with view_image; MIME prefix corrected from application/octet-stream to image/png for display only, preserving identical bytes. Correct larger YouTube label, all words once, full uncropped abstract scene and chat/video geometry retained.
